note.label: Living Your Life As A Hireling

precepts.why:
The man of God out of Judah was charged by the word of the Lord, “Eat no bread, nor drink water, nor turn again by the same way that thou camest.” The Lord told him what not to do and what to do. He refused the king, even for half his house. Then an old prophet in Bethel came after him: “I am a prophet also as thou art; and an angel spake unto me by the word of the Lord, saying, Bring him back with thee into thine house, that he may eat bread and drink water. But he lied unto him.”

This dude was lying. God said the only one he speaks with mouth to mouth is Moses; everybody else he speaks to with dreams and visions, and this man said an angel came to him. The man of God went back, ate and drank, and “a lion met him by the way, and slew him”: “It is the man of God, who was disobedient unto the word of the Lord”.

That is why the Lord said, “Take ye heed every one of his neighbour, and trust ye not in any brother: for every brother will utterly supplant, and every neighbour will walk with slanders.” That is why you have to be mindful with brothers. If God tells you something, follow it; don’t go to the left or right of what he says because a brother says so. Follow the Lamb whithersoever he goeth.

Some people are in your life for blessings, some are in your life for cursings; but ultimately it is to try us, each and every one of us.

precepts.text: Trust ye not in any brother: for every brother will utterly supplant, and every neighbour will walk with slanders. They have taught their tongue to speak lies; there are some very good liars out there.
precepts.point: But when their hatred went so far, that by one of Simon's faction murders were committed: Simon hated Onias so much he had one of his men kill one of Onias's priests. That is why I say it is never just one thing; it is a domino effect of sins.
precepts.why:
“Take ye heed every one of his neighbour, and trust ye not in any brother: for every brother will utterly supplant, and every neighbour will walk with slanders.”

Every neighbour will walk with slanders. “And they will deceive every one his neighbour, and will not speak the truth: they have taught their tongue to speak lies, and weary themselves to commit iniquity.”

There are people who love the slander. They teach their tongue to speak lies, and they are very good at it; there are some very good liars out there. You ever see a woman caught in the midst of adultery? She starts crying: this is not what it looks like. And some men will dismiss what they saw with their own eyes. Some of you are such a simp.

Don’t bring anybody like that around. They cannot roll with us. Let them stay over there with those other camps. That is what Simon was: a brother that supplanted, walked with slanders, and would not speak the truth about Onias.

precepts.text: Oh that I had in the wilderness a lodging place, that I might leave my people, for they be all adulterers: separate from the unbelievers and set up a righteous underground railroad for believers, selfless instead of selfish.
precepts.point: Not sell your last, but consolidate your excess, because this place is over and the tribulation is coming while you run up credit cards.
precepts.why:
Jeremiah cries, “Oh that I had in the wilderness a lodging place of wayfaring men; that I might leave my people, and go from them! for they be all adulterers, an assembly of treacherous men.” As these times come to pass, we have to strive to be among each other and to separate ourselves from these other nations and from the unbelievers, because they will continue to come for us.

That lodging place is what the believers in Acts 2 had. “All that believed were together, and had all things common”, and they “sold their possessions and goods, and parted them to all men, as every man had need.” Nothing was lacking among them. They were on one accord, breaking bread from house to house, on one accord with their finances, making sure no one who was lacking was left in a constraint. “And the Lord added to the church daily such as should be saved.”

What the Lord wants us to set up in these last days is a righteous underground railroad: looking out for the believers, the ones striving and getting themselves together. That means being selfless instead of selfish. It does not mean sell your last. It means that if you have excess, start consolidating, because this place is over.

Too many are still running up their credit cards and putting everything in debt, not realizing the tribulation that is coming. As the tribulation happens we have to align ourselves with what the Lord is telling us to do: come out from among the adulterers and treacherous men, and make a lodging place for the believers.

precepts.text: Oh that I had in the wilderness a lodging place, that I might leave my people, for they are all adulterers who bend their tongues for lies and are not valiant for the truth: valiant in the theatre for Nat Turner and Malcolm, but not on the earth.
precepts.point: Alas, for that day is great, so that none is like it; it is the time of Jacob's trouble, but he shall be saved out of it.
precepts.why:
“We have heard a voice of trembling, of fear, and not of peace.” We are coming up on that moment now. And yet our people cheer the movies on Martin Luther King and Malcolm X. You may not agree with Martin's method, but how many of us would walk down the street knowing we would be beaten, jailed and have dogs sicced on us? Their stand ended Jim Crow, and in sixty years of that liberty, how have we used it? We shoot each other, besmirch one another and hate each other.

Jeremiah said, “Oh that I had in the wilderness a lodging place of wayfaring men; that I might leave my people, and go from them!” He wanted to leave black people. Why? “for they be all adulterers, an assembly of treacherous men. And they bend their tongues like their bow for lies”. Black people love to use their lips for lies.

“but they are not valiant for the truth upon the earth”. They are valiant in the movie theatre. They cheer on Nat Turner in Birth of a Nation, cheer on Malcolm X and Martin Luther King, cheer the resistance in The Hunger Games and Star Wars, but they do not have that spirit and do not have the balls to do what those men did. They would never have joined Malcolm or Martin, and many will not join us out of fear. Two young boys got shot in the face in Georgia, instigated by a gaggle of other black men who scattered like cockroaches and played innocent when the cops came. So-called revolutionary brothers on podcasts call us a cult while including homosexuality and transgenderism; they have never left the couch.

“for they proceed from evil to evil, and they know not me, saith the Lord.” That is why, in the time of Jacob's trouble, there is a voice of trembling and fear and not of peace.

precepts.text: They bend their tongues like their bow for lies, but they are not valiant for the truth. Instead of teaching the commandments they concoct sayings to look wise and bewitch you a little at a time, until you are sitting under a man calling Jesus a stripper and see nothing wrong.
precepts.point: Because judgment is not executed speedily they think they can say anything about Jesus; he is writing it in a book and coming back to say, say that to my face. That is how you know Jesus is a black man.

note.label: Fixx Ya Face Fridays | as Was Supposed!!

precepts.why:
“And they bend their tongues like their bow for lies”. Instead of just keeping God's commandments and teaching God's commandments, they concoct wise sayings to look a certain way in front of men. What they are really doing is trying to bewitch you, dropping a little in your windows here and there, until the next thing you know you're sitting in a congregation where he's saying Jesus is a stripper, supporting it, and seeing nothing wrong with it.

They want to explain Christ in a negative light, or raise money by talking about Diddy coming out, because the people they are reaching have defiled minds. They aren't leading them back to God; they keep them in the same state. When you can get people to laugh at something that foul, it is because it engages their spirit: you are tapping into something familiar to them that they have not cast out. Our job is to lead them away from that mentality, and these men are trying to keep them in it.

Then, “but they are not valiant for the truth upon the earth”. All they have to do is keep God's commandments. How about you be valiant about doing what God actually tells you to do? Enoch said the Lord comes to convince the ungodly of their hard speeches against him, and these bent tongues are those hard speeches.

precepts.text: Let him that glorieth glory in this, that he understandeth and knoweth me, that I exercise lovingkindness, judgment, and righteousness in the earth.
precepts.point: The fear of the Lord is all wisdom, Sirach 19:20, and in all wisdom is the performance of the law: be about it, not just talk about it. If you do not fear the Lord, that is where your problems are.
precepts.why:
“O Lord, be gracious unto us; we have waited for thee”: that is our prayer, just like Hezekiah prayed. We have to wait on the Lord. “The Lord is exalted; for he dwelleth on high: he hath filled Zion with judgment and righteousness.”

Jeremiah 9:24 shows what Israel glories in: “But let him that glorieth glory in this, that he understandeth and knoweth me, that I am the Lord which exercise lovingkindness, judgment, and righteousness, in the earth: for in these things I delight, saith the Lord.” That is what we have to glory in, brothers: that we understand and know the Lord.

All nations do not understand and know the Lord, so they do not glory in the Lord. The judgment and righteousness the Lord delights to exercise in the earth are the same judgment and righteousness he has filled Zion with. Knowing him is Israel's glory, while the nations are scattered at the lifting up of himself.

precepts.text: Oh that I had in the wilderness a lodging place of wayfaring men, that I might leave my people, for they be all adulterers, an assembly of treacherous men; they bend their tongues like their bow for lies, they are not valiant for the truth, they proceed from evil to evil, and they know not me.
precepts.point: Our enemies are the enemies of God, the other nations. Here we are unapologetically biblical; take it up with God.

note.label: There Is No Hate Like Christian Love

precepts.why:
“And thou, even thyself, shalt discontinue from thine heritage that I gave thee”. Even Jeremiah, who was not a wicked man, still went into captivity and had to deal with the same things as all the wicked Israelites. And look at how Jeremiah felt about his people, knowing how wicked we are.

“Oh that I had in the wilderness a lodging place of wayfaring men; that I might leave my people, and go from them!” Far away in the wilderness, just to get away from these people. They look just like him and he grew up with them, but he wants to get away from them. Why? “for they be all adulterers, an assembly of treacherous men.”

“And they bend their tongues like their bow for lies”. Do black people do a lot of lying? Yes, we do. “but they are not valiant for the truth upon the earth; for they proceed from evil to evil, and they know not me, saith the Lord.” They move from evil to evil and they do not know God.

That is the black Christian. Do not let them fool you. They can quote the popular scriptures all day, John 3:16, neither Jew nor Greek, no weapon formed against me shall prosper, and say God got me. No, Satan got you. You and Satan are like my buddy and me. That is why the Lord says Israel shall discontinue from its heritage and serve its enemies in a land it knew not: a people who know him not.

precepts.text: All my inward friends abhorred me, and they whom I loved are turned against me.
precepts.point: They have taught their tongue to speak lies. Some brethren online slander the bishops, deacons and captains every chance they get.
precepts.why:
“Take ye heed every one of his neighbour, and trust ye not in any brother: for every brother will utterly supplant, and every neighbour will walk with slanders.” To supplant is to betray, to plot. Job knew what it is to be betrayed by those closest to him: “All my inward friends abhorred me: and they whom I loved are turned against me.”

That is how Maduro was taken in Venezuela. It was betrayal from within. His own elite bodyguards, handpicked for their loyalty and trained to take a bullet for him, took American money instead. The outer guards were told to stand down, the cameras and alarms were disabled, and the last two bodyguards surrendered without firing a single shot. The same thing happened to Jovenel in Haiti. Those were our people, the northern kingdom, and they handed him over. And Esau planned it for more than a year, studying who could be turned: one with a sick daughter, one bitter that others were promoted over him, one disillusioned.

The same spirit is among us. Other Israelite camps want to destroy IUIC by slandering the members and the leadership, because black people will believe anything without proof. They slander the Bishop, the deacons and the captains every chance they get, and then come to the door asking to fellowship. We are good. We don't believe the same thing, and we will never come together with them.

And inside: the brother who says, why is he a captain, I know more scripture than him, why do the young men always travel with the Bishop? Maybe the young men are thirstier for the word than you. They know they don't know everything; you think you know it all. Fix that spirit, or you will be the next traitor, the inward friend turned against those who loved him. God hates a traitor.

precepts.text: To refuse to know Him through deceit is to have no relationship with Him.
precepts.point: They have taught their tongue to speak lies and weary themselves to commit iniquity; through deceit they refuse to know the Most High.
precepts.why:
“Ye neither know me, nor my Father: if ye had known me, ye should have known my Father also.” To refuse to know him through deceit is to have no relationship with him. That is the end of “Thine habitation is in the midst of deceit; through deceit they refuse to know me, saith the Lord.”

They have taught their tongue to speak lies and weary themselves to commit iniquity. Every brother will utterly supplant and every neighbor walks with slanders, so “trust ye not in any brother”. We have seen this in IUIC and in many of the other camps. A people that lives in deceit does not know the Father, and does not know Christ either.

points: That empathy that we have in our spirit for our people, that's normal; that's perfectly normal. We're supposed to feel that for our people. They our own flesh and blood, descendants of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. But there's balance to it: we still got to stay in the spirit.

This is Jeremiah speaking about the plight, the condition of Israel during this time period. Jeremiah used to feel in his spirit for the calamities that was going on with our people also during his day. He said, man, I want to cry; I wish I could just cry all day for the slain of my people.

For death is come up into our windows: every time we turn on the news, the television, social media, all we see is our people being put to death. Police lynchings unsolved left and right. Every time we turn around, another one of our people's put to death: Sandra Bland, Sonia Macy, Tamir Rice, Eric Garner; the list goes on and on and on. And it's entered into our palaces: we can't escape it; sometimes it hit close to home, loved ones getting put to death. To cut off the children from without, and the young men from the streets: our people dropping like flies left and right.
Take ye heed every one of his neighbour, and trust ye not in any brother, for every brother will utterly supplant and every neighbour will walk with slanders.
They have taught their tongue to speak lies. Some brethren online slander the bishops, deacons and captains every chance they get.

The prophet wishes his head were waters and his eyes a fountain of tears to weep for the slain of his people. He wants a lodging place in the wilderness to leave them, because they are all adulterers and treacherous men who bend their tongues like a bow for lies and proceed from evil to evil.
Trust not in any brother, for every brother will supplant and every neighbor walks with slanders. We have seen this in IUIC and in many of the other camps.
They have taught their tongue to speak lies and weary themselves to commit iniquity; through deceit they refuse to know the Most High.

The Most High will melt and try them, because their tongue is an arrow shooting deceit. A man speaks peaceably to his neighbor with his mouth but in his heart lies in wait, thinking of a plot or scheme to destroy, steal from, or overcome him. That is how wicked our people are.

Because they forsook His law, did not obey His voice, and walked after the imagination of their own heart and after Baal, He will feed them with wormwood, give them water of gall, scatter them among the heathen, and send a sword after them until they are consumed.

Call for the mourning women to take up a wailing, for death has come up into the windows and into the palaces to cut off the children from the streets and the young men from the squares. This sounds like America, like the south side of Chicago, north Dallas, and southwest Houston.
Let not the wise man glory in his wisdom, the mighty in his might, or the rich in his riches. Carnal things like looks, strength, and money all fade.

Glory instead that you understand and know the Most High: that you have been awakened in these last days, shown the truth, the scriptures, the commandments, and what God requires to be saved from the destruction prophesied to come.

The days come when He will punish the circumcised along with the uncircumcised, because all the house of Israel is uncircumcised in the heart. It does not matter if you are circumcised after the manner of Abraham; if you fornicate or hold hatred, your circumcision is made uncircumcision through your sin. Circumcision only means something when you are obedient to the words and statutes of the Lord.
